archiegregorysmith: Bram Archiegregor arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a bullet that missed him and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Edmund Potato of the Hegemony and Bram Archiegregor of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch.

A flare caught Bram Archiegregor halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. The Concord took Verdel Ridge, and the orders at S-F17 changed before the cheering ended. Bram Archiegregor shouldered another load.
